title: Laaye shahe deen maqtal se aon o mohd ke lashe
body:
Laaye Shahe Dee’N Maqtal Se, Aun O Mohammed Asws, Ke Lashe.
1. Kijiye Amma Shukre Quda Hogaye Dono Haq Pe Fida. Kehte The Yeh Zainab Sa. Se.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Maa Ki Naseehat Ka Tha Asar Ki Na Nazar Bhi Dariya Par. Door Bohot The Saahil Se.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ran Mein Lahoo Se Ghusl Kiye. Tan Pe Kafan Zaqmo’N Ka Liye. Ganje Shaheeda’N Mein Pohonche.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Rone Lage Sab Ehle Haram. Uthnr Laga Shore Matam. Qaime Mein Jis Dam Aaye.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dil Mein Liye Toofane Alam. Nauha Kuna Ba Chashme Nam. Hasrat Se Sheh Takte The.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Binte Ali Sa., Ne Sheh Se Kaha. Bhayi Baraye Deene Quda. Hai Yahi Zainab Sa., Ke Fidye.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shaame Alam Zainab Dukhiya.  Behre Madad Deti Thi Sada. Maa Ki Sada Sun Kar Tadpe
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Zainab Sa. Ne Dekhe Yawar. Naizo Par Wo Phool Se Sar.  Jalti Zamee’N Par The Haaye.
Az: Shayer E Ahlebait As., Janab Yawar Ali Yawar Sahab
